title: Not able to set up my own order
body:
I really enjoy using the Tasks app and it helps me stay organized every day. However, one challenge I’m facing is that my tasks don’t stay in the order I arrange them. Each day they reset and appear in a different sequence.
For me, it’s very important to have tasks in a specific order, since I use them as side work and need to follow them step by step. It would be extremely helpful if the app allowed me to set and lock a custom order for my tasks, so they stay exactly as I arrange them.
Thank you for considering this feature — it would make the app much more effective for people who need structured workflows.
author: Hangout Blg

title: Shared lists
body:
Very neat and user-friendly app. I love the simplicity. Perfect for every-day as well ad repetitive tasks. 
Would be great if lists could be shared with friends and family. I couldn’t find such an option.
